meta.title: Ormaro · Second-hand in Montenegro
meta.description: Buy and sell second-hand in Montenegro. List in your own language, chat, meet up.

home.tagline: Buy and sell second-hand in Montenegro.
home.empty: No listings yet. Be the first to post one!

search.title: Search
search.noResults: Nothing matches this search. Try removing some filters.

listing.safety: Meet face to face in a busy place. Don't pay before you see the item.

sell.title: Sell something
sell.photosHint: 1 to 8 photos. The first one is the cover.
sell.languageHint: Your listing is shown in the language you write it in.

errors.storageMissing: Posting is switched off for now: photo storage isn't set up yet.
errors.uploadFailed: A photo couldn't be uploaded. Remove it and try again.
errors.tooManyPhotos: You can add up to 8 photos.
errors.titleInvalid: The title must be 3 to 120 characters long.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emptyFavorites: Listings you save will show up here.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to post listings, send messages and save favourites.
login.error: Couldn't log you in. Please try again.
login.terms: By continuing you accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
login.registerSubtitle: We'll send a 6-digit verification code to your email.
login.name: Your name
login.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. If it's not there, check your spam folder.
login.codeHint: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
login.codeResent: A new code has been sent.
login.forgotSubtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a code to reset your password.
login.resetSubtitle: If {email} is registered, we've sent a 6-digit code to it. Enter the code and your new password.
login.mailRegisterBody:
Hello,

Your code to finish signing up for Ormaro: {code}

It's valid for 15 minutes. If you didn't sign up, you can ignore this email.

Ormaro
login.mailResetBody:
Hello,

Your code to reset your Ormaro password: {code}

It's valid for 15 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; your password won't change.

Ormaro

errors.name: Your name must be 2 to 60 characters.
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.mailUnavailable: Email sign-up isn't available yet. For now you can continue with Google.
errors.mailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a bit.
errors.tooSoon: Wait a minute before asking for a new code.
errors.tooMany: Too many codes requested for this address. Try again in an hour.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Ask for a new code.

chat.title: Messages
chat.empty: No messages yet. Tap “Send a message” on a listing you like.
chat.safety: Meet face to face in a busy place. Don't pay before you see the item.
chat.acceptedNote: The {amount} offer was accepted. Agree on a place and time here.
chat.firstMessage: Write the first message. You could ask if it's still available.
chat.listingRemoved: This listing was removed, so new messages can't be sent.

errors.empty: You can't send an empty message.
errors.tooLong: Message is too long (2000 characters max).

review.title: Leave a review
review.already: You've already reviewed this listing. Thanks!
review.notAllowed: You can leave a review once both of you have written in this conversation.
review.ratingRequired: Please choose a rating from 1 to 5.
review.question: How was your deal with {name}?
review.commentHint: Your comment will be public on {name}'s profile.

report.title: Report
report.doneBody: Our team will review it and take action if needed. Thank you.
report.privacy: Your name isn't shown to the person you report.

app.title: App
app.installBody: Ormaro is added to your home screen and opens like an app.
app.installIos: In Safari, tap the Share button (square with an up arrow), then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
app.installOther: From your browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.

push.needsInstall: On iPhone, first add Ormaro to your home screen, open it from there and turn on notifications here.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked on this device. Allow them for Ormaro in your browser's site settings.
push.off: Get a notification on your phone when a new message or offer arrives.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
push.error: Couldn't turn on notifications. Try again.

app.nudge: Want a notification when they reply?
